title: Crude fell 17% in 3 weeks. Your petrol price didn't move.
description:
Brent crude dropped from $116 (Oct 23 peak) to $96 today — a 17% fall in just 3 weeks. Yet Delhi petrol stays at ₹102.12/L, unchanged all November.

Who controls when global oil price changes actually reach your fuel pump? Watch to find out.
